AT APPROXIMATELY 0930 HRS. A REPORT WAS RECEIVED OF A RAINBOW FUEL SHEEN IN THE WATER ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THE SHILSHOLE BAY MARINA FUEL DOCK. MARINA STAFF RESPONDED AND LOCATED THE SOURCE OF THE SPILL. THE SOURCE OF THE DIESEL FUEL WAS COMING FROM THE 56' RECREATION VESSEL, LAZY DUCK IV. THE VESSEL OWNER WAS CONTACTED ON BOARD HIS BOAT AT I DOCK, SLIP 17 AT SHILSHOLE BAY MARINA. THE OWNER INDICATED THAT HE HAD TRANSFERRED DIESEL FUEL FROM ONE TANK TO ANOTHER AND SOME OF THE DIESEL SPILLED OUT THE AIR VENT ONTO THE AFT DECK. VESSEL OWNER HAD A CREW CLEANING THE DECK AND THE FUEL WAS WASHED OVERBOARD INTO THE WATER. VESSEL OWNER WAS TOLD NOT TO ALLOW FUEL TO GO INTO THE WATER.

properties.content:

Nearest City: Cape Girardeau, MO

Location2: CEMENT MANUFACTURING FACILITY
Incident Type: FIXED

Suspected Responsible Party: LONE STAR INDUSTRIES, INC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.268159, -89.536479 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 380 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER STATES A CARRIER LINE AT THE FACILITY FAILED DUE TO CORROSION. THIS RESULTED IN THE DISCHARGE OF THE 380 GALLONS OF THE WATER SOLUBLE CHEMICAL AIRALON (CT-362/SDS 56082) . THIS SPILL OCCURRED ON AN OUTDOOR CONCRETE SURFACE AND AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT HAS FLOWED INTO ON-SITE STORM DRAINS. THESE DRAINS LEAD INTO A SOIL DITCH SYSTEM THAT DRAINS TO THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER IN THE EAST AND AN ON-SITE LAKE IN THE WEST. CALLER REPORTS THAT SPILL IS CURRENTLY MOVING WEST TOWARDS THE LAKE. CALLER STATES THAT THEY HAVE SHUT THE VALVE GATE TO THE LAKE TO PREVENT MATERIAL FROM REACHING IT. THE MATERIAL HAS CHANGED THE DITCH WATER TO A WHITISH/MILKY CONSISTENCY. CALLER REPORTS THAT THE LEAK HAS NOT BEEN CONFIRMED SECURED AT THIS TIME. THE SPILL HAS BEEN BERMED OFF ON THE CONCRETE, AND AN OSRO HAS ARRIVED ON-SITE TO ASSIST WITH CLEAN-UP.

Medium Affected: LAND

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.007015, -88.854972 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS A PASSENGER WORK TRUCK WAS INVOLVED IN A TRAFFIC ACCIDENT. THE RESPONDING FIRE DEPARTMENT DISCOVERED THAT THIS TRUCK IS CARRYING A CONTAINER OF RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS THAT WITH DIMENSIONS 2FT X 1.5 FT X 3 FT. IT IS AN ORANGE CARRYING CASE CLEARLY MARKED AS CONTAINING RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS. THE VEHICLE DOES NOT HAVE A DOT NUMBER AND IS NOT DISPLAYING A PLACARD. ASSOCIATED DOCUMENTS INDICATE THE CONTENTS AS FOLLOWS: CESIUM-137 - 79 MILLICURIES, AMERICUM-241 / BERYLLIUM - 350 MILLICURIES, RADIUM-226 - 38.5 MILLICURIES. THE DOCUMENTS INDICATE THAT THESE ARE "SEALED SOURCES." THE CASE WAS JOSTLED IN THE ACCIDENT, BUT THERE IS NO APPARENT DAMAGE OR RELEASE AT THIS TIME. THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT ON-SCENE IS FOLLOWING THE EMERGENCY RESPONSE MEASURES ON THE ATTACHED PAPERWORK, WHICH INDICATE STAYING 10-15 AWAY AND UPWIND FROM THE INCIDENT. THE DRIVER DECLINED TRANSPORT TO THE HOSPITAL. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT IS SEEKING HIGHER-LEVEL GUIDANCE ON HOW TO PROCEED, BUT IS CURRENTLY WORKING WITH THE RESPONSIBLE COMPANY FOR FURTHER REMEDIATION EFFORTS.

properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 923811
Incident Time: 2009-11-09 16:12:00
Nearest City: Richmond, VA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: WASTE OIL
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
THERE IS ILLEGAL DUMPING OF OIL, AND HYDROCARBON FLUIDS ONTO THE GROUND THAT OCCURRED ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS. SCRAP VEHICLES ARE BEING CHOPPED UP TO SELL THE METAL. THESE VEHICLES WERE PERSONALLY OPERATED VEHICLES AS WELL AS CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT, AND HEAVY COMMERCIAL TRUCKS. THE COMPANY BURIES THE SPILLED OIL WITH THE OTHER CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT. THE ENTIRE BACK AREA HAS BEEN RAISED BY DUMPING BRICK, CONCRETE, STUMPS AND OTHER DEBRIS AND COVERING IT UP WITH DIRT. SOME OF THIS DIRT WAS DUG UP FROM SEWER PROJECTS AND IT DOES CONTAIN SOME FECAL MATTER. THERE IS A STREAM BEHIND THE YARD BY THE TREE LINE NEXT TO THE RAILROAD TRACKS. REBAR, AND SOME ASSORTED GARBAGE ARE ALSO BURIED THERE. MANY LAYERS ARE PRESENT. ABOUT 10 FEET OF LAND RAISING HAS OCCURRED, WITH PILES OF ALL SORTS BURIED. THE SHOP AREA INSIDE THE GARAGE HAS HAD COUNTLESS GALLONS OF WASTE FLUIDS THAT RAN INTO THE DRAINS ON THE FLOOR. IT MIGHT HAVE A CATCH SYSTEM, BUT IT IS NEVER PUMPED. THE GRAVEL PARKING AREA OUT FRONT ALSO CONTAINS A LOT OF OF OIL LEAKING FROM THE TRUCKS AND NO REPAIRS ARE MADE TO THE TRUCKS.

SOME OF THIS DIRT WAS DUG UP FROM SEWER PROJECTS AND IT DOES CONTAIN SOME FECAL MATTER. THERE IS A STREAM BEHIND THE YARD BY THE TREE LINE NEXT TO THE RAILROAD TRACKS. REBAR, AND SOME ASSORTED GARBAGE ARE ALSO BURIED THERE. MANY LAYERS ARE PRESENT. ABOUT 10 FEET OF LAND RAISING HAS OCCURRED, WITH PILES OF ALL SORTS BURIED. THE SHOP AREA INSIDE THE GARAGE HAS HAD COUNTLESS GALLONS OF WASTE FLUIDS THAT RAN INTO THE DRAINS ON THE FLOOR. IT MIGHT HAVE A CATCH SYSTEM, BUT IT IS NEVER PUMPED. THE GRAVEL PARKING AREA OUT FRONT ALSO CONTAINS A LOT OF OF OIL LEAKING FROM THE TRUCKS AND NO REPAIRS ARE MADE TO THE TRUCKS.
